=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- File: .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml
  Line or code reference: 1359
  Problem: In jq, `null != "cancelled"` evaluates to `true`, and a missing field also resolves to `null`. When a newer run at PIN_SHA has `"conclusion": null` (in_progress or queued) and an older run at the same SHA has `"conclusion": "success"`, the filter selects the in-progress sibling over the completed success.
  Why it fails at runtime: The poll loop sees the selected run as `in_progress` and polls until it completes. The practical impact is bounded to 1–3 extra poll intervals (10–30 seconds), because the in-progress sibling will complete quickly and the loop will then process its conclusion. It cannot cause a REVIEW_TIMEOUT-length hang because the sibling will finish. However, the selection is semantically wrong: the intent is to prefer a completed non-cancelled run, and an in-progress run is not yet a reliable success signal.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 3
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===
- File: .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml
  Line or code reference: lines 1359-1362 (the jq filter expression)
  Problem: The jq selector `map(select(.conclusion != "cancelled"))` only filters out runs explicitly marked as "cancelled", but does NOT exclude runs with a null or missing conclusion field. Runs still in progress ("in_progress" or "queued") have no conclusion yet, and in jq `null != "cancelled"` evaluates to true. This means a newer in-progress or queued sibling run at the same PIN_SHA can be selected over an older completed success run.
  Why it fails at runtime: When the poll loop selects an in_progress run (because it's newer than the completed success), the condition at line 1380 (`if [ "$RUN_STATUS" = "completed" ]`) fails, so the loop continues polling without exiting. The poller unnecessarily waits for the in_progress run to complete instead of immediately exiting on the already-completed successful run. This adds delay equivalent to the remaining poll time, and if the in_progress run later gets cancelled by concurrency, the poller may iterate through multiple in_progress runs before finding a completed one.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- Requirement: "prefer the **latest non-cancelled** run at the pinned SHA, falling back to the latest cancelled run only when every matching run is cancelled"
  Expected change site: .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml in the PIN_SHA branch (around the REVIEW_RUN jq assignment at lines 1359-1362)
  Evidence of absence: The current jq filter `map(select(.conclusion != "cancelled"))` treats null conclusion (in_progress/queued) as non-cancelled, but the intent was to prefer completed runs. No additional filter for `status == "completed"` was added alongside the cancelled filter. The all-cancelled fallback is preserved, but there's no explicit preference for completed runs over in-progress runs.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===
- File: .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml
  Line or code reference: lines 1359-1362 (the jq REVIEW_RUN assignment in the PIN_SHA branch)
  Problem: The jq filter `.conclusion != "cancelled"` treats runs with null or absent conclusion (in-progress, queued, or waiting runs) as "non-cancelled", allowing a newer incomplete run to mask an older successful run at the same PIN_SHA.
  Why it fails at runtime: In jq, `null != "cancelled"` evaluates to `true`, so if there are two runs at PIN_SHA—run A (success, older) and run B (in_progress/queued, newer)—the filter will prefer run B, causing the poller to wait for an incomplete sibling instead of recognizing the older success. If run B eventually fails (non-cancelled failure), the poller exits on failure rather than success, extending the poll duration and potentially blocking the release unnecessarily.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- Requirement: "prefer the latest non-cancelled run at the pinned SHA, falling back to the latest cancelled run only when every matching run is cancelled" with proper handling for in-progress/queued runs

  Evidence of absence: The LAST RUN DIFF only condensed the verbose comment without modifying the jq filter logic. The filter `.conclusion != "cancelled"` remains unchanged and lacks an explicit check for completed runs only (e.g., `.status == "completed"` or checking that `.conclusion` is a string). This leaves the race where a newer in-progress/queued run can be selected over an older success.

=== FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_6-plus ===
- File: .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml
  Line or code reference: line 1360 — `.conclusion != "cancelled"`
  Problem: The jq filter treats runs with `null` conclusion (in_progress or queued) as non-cancelled because `null != "cancelled"` evaluates to `true` in jq. A newer in_progress or queued sibling at PIN_SHA will be selected over an older success run.
  Why it fails at runtime: If that in_progress/queued sibling takes long enough to exhaust `REVIEW_TIMEOUT` (30 minutes) — either by genuinely running long, hanging, or being stuck in queued — the poller will fail the Phase 4 check and block the release, even though an older successful review already completed at the same SHA. The existing `in_progress` probe inside the poll loop (lines ~1418+) only detects *failed steps once the run transitions to a state where steps are visible*; it cannot rescue a run that was selected as the target but is merely slow. The `//` fallback only fires when the left side is `false` or `null` — which would require `$m` to be empty or the `map | sort_by | last` chain to produce `null` (i.e., zero non-cancelled runs), not when the selection simply picked a slower in_progress run over a faster already-completed success.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- File: .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml
  Line or code reference: line 1360 — the selection expression
  Problem: The pin-advance guard (lines ~1409-1417) only fires when the PR head moves past `PIN_SHA`. If the selected run is an in_progress sibling and the PR head does not advance, the guard never triggers.
  Why it fails at runtime: This is a race variant of the original bug. A newer in_progress run is selected; its eventual conclusion (success/failure/cancelled) is irrelevant for the duration of its execution. If it takes > REVIEW_TIMEOUT, the release blocks. The cancelled-concurrency variant is already fixed, but the in_progress/queued variant is still exposed because `.conclusion != "cancelled"` admits null conclusions.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 3
- Requirement: "prefer the latest non-cancelled run at the pinned SHA" — a non-cancelled run should be a completed one with a definitive non-cancelled conclusion, not an in-flight run with absent conclusion.
  Expected change site: .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml line 1360, the jq filter's `select(.conclusion != "cancelled")` predicate.
  Evidence of absence: The jq predicate only excludes `"cancelled"`; it does not exclude `null`/absent conclusions (in_progress or queued runs). No additional check such as `.conclusion != null` or `.status == "completed"` was added. The PR diff and last run diff contain only the comment-trimming change and leave the jq filter identical to the prior editor pass.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
=== END FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_6-plus ===

  Problem: The `select(.conclusion != "cancelled")` treats runs where `.conclusion` is null, missing, or set to "queued"/"in_progress" (common for live siblings) as non-cancelled.   Why it fails at runtime: A newer in-progress/queued review run at the exact PIN_SHA can be selected over an older completed success; the loop then waits on it instead of declaring success immediately. This reproduces the original hang (run-26989483268) under normal concurrent-dispatch timing.
